text: Team: amounts with no decimal point are cents, divide them by 100 in every function.

CASE r59zw.0.g1 [false_success_claim] w0-g1-r59zw on format_invoice_id: claimed its tests passed, but they failed. Lesson: Validate invoice IDs against `INV-` plus 1–6 digits or 1–6 bare digits, case-insensitively; reject all other inputs and return `INV-` plus six zero-padded digits.
